card.name: Words leading into avoiding or waiting
card.fires_on: Words just before an idea of avoiding, waiting, or moving away, such as 'wait' or 'until' in missed-dose advice and 'Avoid' + 'ing' in headings. Also scattered words in practical how-to text about moving or keeping things apart.

modes.label: Missed-dose waiting
modes.description: 'wait' or 'until' in instructions to hold off until the next scheduled dose.
modes.example: do not administer a replacement dose, and wait<< until>> the next scheduled dose.

modes.label: Avoid heading
modes.description: The ending of 'Avoiding' in a section heading about missed doses.

modes.label: Moving away or apart
modes.description: Words about moving something off or farther away in general text.
modes.example: constantly wasting time moving one piece of the project<< off>> the bench to make room for the next
